thread.title: Daily Dividend Report: ARCC, LFUS, VNOM, MAIN, AAPL, AMGN, SYK

title: Daily Dividend Report: ARCC, LFUS, VNOM, MAIN, AAPL, AMGN, SYK
text:
Daily Dividend Report: ARCC, LFUS, VNOM, MAIN, AAPL, AMGN, SYK Wednesday, August 1, 3:06 PM ET 10 Oversold Dividend Stocks » Ares Capital Corporation (NASDAQ: ARCC ) has declared a third quarter dividend of $0.39 per share, an increase of $0.01 per share over the prior quarter dividend. The third quarter dividend is payable on September 28, 2018 to stockholders of record as of September 14, 2018.
Littelfuse (NASDAQ: LFUS ) approved a 16% increase in the quarterly cash dividend from $0.37 to $0.43. This equates to an annualized dividend of $1.72 per share. The dividend will be paid on September 6, 2018 to shareholders of record as of August 23, 2018.
The Board of Directors of Viper's general partner has declared a cash distribution of $0.600 per common unit for the three-month period ended June 30, 2018, payable on August 20, 2018 to common unitholders of record as of the close of business on August 13, 2018.
Main Street Capital (NYSE: MAIN ) declared regular monthly cash dividends of $0.195 per share for each of October, November and December 2018. These monthly dividends, which will be payable pursuant to the table below, total $0.585 per share for the fourth quarter of 2018 and represent a 2.6% increase from both the regular monthly dividends paid for the fourth quarter of 2017 and the regular monthly dividends declared for the third quarter of 2018.
Apple has declared a cash dividend of $0.73 per share of the Company's common stock. The dividend is payable on August 16, 2018 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on August 13, 2018.
Amgen (NASDAQ: AMGN ) declared a $1.32 per share dividend for the third quarter of 2018. The dividend will be paid on Sept. 7, 2018, to all stockholders of record as of the close of business on Aug. 17, 2018.
Stryker Corporation (NYSE: SYK ) has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.47 per share payable on October 31, 2018 to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 28, 2018, representing an increase of approximately 11% versus the prior year and unchanged from the previous quarter.
For MarketNewsVideo.com, I'm Sayoko Murase.
